description: HTTP request smuggling (CL.TE/TE.CL/TE.TE/CL.0) — desync front-end and back-end to poison other users' requests. Load behind a proxy/CDN/load-balancer, on "smuggling/desync", or when Content-Length vs Transfer-Encoding handling differs.
